name: How long does slab leak repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does slab leak repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of slab leak repair depends on the chosen method and the complexity of the leak. Simple spot repairs might be completed within a day. More extensive re-routing or pipe lining projects could take several days, especially if access is difficult or if multiple sections of pipe need addressing. The detection phase itself can take a few hours. Alpha-Plumbing Services aims to minimize disruption and will provide an estimated timeline after assessing your specific leak.
acceptedAnswer.description: Slab leak repair can take from a few hours to several days, depending on the leak's complexity and the repair method used.
